description: Machine-readable expected outcome for every fixture in this directory. `verify-fixtures.mjs` reads this file and fails (non-zero exit) if any fixture's actual outcome does not match.
lane_alignment_note: Checked against lane's ImpactScanSnapshotSchema (packages/schemas/src/estimate.ts, read-only reference) and its consumer parser (packages/core/src/impact-scan.ts). lane's internal schema has one extra required field, `digest`, that this contract's schema deliberately does not have -- this is not a drift to reconcile. lane's own parser (RawImpactScanBlock in impact-scan.ts) reads exactly this shape off the wire (scan_version, repo_commit, candidate_paths[], candidate_layers[], open_items?) with NO digest field, then computes digest itself from candidate_paths+candidate_layers before constructing the full internal ImpactScanSnapshot. So lane's wire-level expectation and this contract are already identical; `digest` only exists on lane's post-parse internal object, never on the block this contract governs.

fixtures.notes: The exact example shape from SKILL.md's spec section, including open_items.
open_items omitted entirely -- optional per the spec table ('省略時は空配列扱い'); this schema does not require a producer to emit an empty array explicitly.
A synthesized risk_score field. Rejected by additionalProperties:false -- enforces the 'raw observations only, no aggregate score' design principle structurally rather than by convention.

A digest field on the block itself. Rejected by additionalProperties:false -- a producer including its own computed digest would otherwise let a stale/hand-edited digest ride along unchallenged; consumers must always compute it themselves.
scan_version="2" -- the current block format is version "1" only.
